title: Noor and the Provision
author: Marguerite Pemberton
blurb: Jonah Zhou, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
